item.title: Drill Shoujo Yui
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hayashigumi
  • 発売日: 2004-10-01
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ドリル少女ユイ
  • 英語名: Drill Shoujo Yui

あらすじ

In the beginning of the 21st century large-scale terrorist activities are carried out by the remnants of the research team survived after the World War II.

Thanks to international special unit the activity of the group is put to an end. Protagonist is the retired member of this unit who travels around Japan 10 years after the incident. He is approached by a woman who proposes to create a new special unit to trace the new suspicious organizations. Protagonist refuses, but changes his mind after seeing member candidate - a young woman who lost relatives in the terrorist attack ten years ago. His life as instructor begins.

item.title: Oyakusoku Love
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hayashigumi
  • 発売日: 2001-06-29
  • スコア: 6.25/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お約束LOVE
  • 英語名: Oyakusoku Love

あらすじ

Main character is an ordinary student. One day a fortune teller claims that there are multiple red threads of fate entangled about the protagonist. In order to break free he needs to spend the night of his next birthday with the special person he likes. The boy does not take it seriously, but a series of fateful encounters makes him think otherwise. He only has three months left till his birthday.
